sentences.zh: 循、傪上變，乃禽廣弘及支黨鞫仗內，付三司訊實，皆殊死。

translations.literal: Xun and Song reported the change; thereupon Guanghong and his partisans were seized and interrogated within the palace, handed to the three judicial offices to verify facts, and all were sentenced to extraordinary death.
translations.idiomatic: Xun and Song informed; Guanghong and his party were seized, tried within the palace, verified by the three judicial offices, and all executed.

sentences.zh: 廣弘臨刑，色自如。

translations.literal: At execution Guanghong's color was as usual.
translations.idiomatic: At execution Guanghong's face never changed.

sentences.zh: 由是禁人不得入觀、祠。

translations.literal: Thereupon people were forbidden to enter to view the mountains and shrines.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter commoners were forbidden to enter the sacred mountains and shrines.

sentences.zh: 杜希全

translations.literal: Du Xiquan
translations.idiomatic: Du Xiquan

sentences.zh: 杜希全，京兆醴泉人。

translations.literal: Du Xiquan was a man of Liquan in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Du Xiquan came from Liquan in Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 以裨將隸郭子儀，積功勞至朔方節度使。

translations.literal: As a lieutenant general he was attached to Guo Ziyi and through accumulated merit and toil reached military commissioner of Shuofang.
translations.idiomatic: He served as lieutenant under Guo Ziyi and rose through merit to commissioner of Shuofang.

sentences.zh: 軍令整嚴，士畏其威。

translations.literal: Army orders were strict and severe; the soldiers feared his awesomeness.
translations.idiomatic: His discipline was severe and the troops feared him.

sentences.zh: 奉天之狩，希全與鄜坊節度使李建徽、鹽州刺史戴休顏、夏州刺史時常春引兵赴難。

translations.literal: During the hunt at Fengtian, Xiquan with the Fufang military commissioner Li Jianhui, the Salt Prefecture prefect Dai Xiuyan, and the Xia Prefecture prefect Shi Changchun led troops to rush to the crisis.
translations.idiomatic: At Dezong's withdrawal to Fengtian, Xiquan marched with Li Jianhui of Fufang, Dai Xiuyan of Salt, and Shi Changchun of Xia to the emperor's aid.

sentences.zh: 次漠谷，為賊邀擊，乘高縱石下之，強弩雜發。

translations.literal: Halting at Mogu Valley, they were intercepted and struck by rebels; from the heights stones were cast down and powerful crossbows were mixed in firing.
translations.idiomatic: At Mogu Valley rebels ambushed them, rolling stones from the heights and loosing powerful crossbows.

sentences.zh: 德宗使援之，不克，還保邠州。

translations.literal: Emperor Dezong sent to rescue them but could not succeed and returned to hold Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Dezong sent relief but failed; they fell back to Bin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 賊平，遷檢校尚書左僕射、靈鹽豐夏節度使，封餘姚郡王。

translations.literal: When the rebels were pacified, he was transferred to Acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and military commissioner of Ling, Salt, Feng, and Xia, enfeoffed Prince of Yuyao Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebellion he was made acting Left Vice Director and commissioner of Ling, Salt, Feng, and Xia, enfeoffed Prince of Yuyao.

sentences.zh: 將即屯，獻《體要》八章，砭切政病。

translations.literal: About to take up his garrison, he presented eight chapters of Essentials, cutting sharply at defects in government.
translations.idiomatic: On taking command he submitted eight chapters of Essentials sharply criticizing government failings.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉納，賜《君臣箴》一篇。

translations.literal: The emperor praised and adopted them and granted one chapter of Admonitions for Ruler and Minister.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and accepted them and granted a chapter of Admonitions for Ruler and Minister.

sentences.zh: 尋兼夏綏銀節度都統，建言：「鹽州據要會，為塞保鄣。

translations.literal: Shortly he also held overall command of the Xia-Sui-Yin circuit and memorialized, saying, "Salt Prefecture occupies a vital junction and is a frontier bulwark.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he also held overall command of Xia-Sui-Yin and memorialized that Salt Prefecture held a vital junction and was the frontier's bulwark.

sentences.zh: 自平涼背盟，城陷於虜，於是靈武勢縣，鄜坊單逼，為邊深患，請復城鹽州。

translations.literal: Since the betrayal of alliance at Pingliang, the city fell to the barbarians; thereupon Lingwu's position was suspended and Fufang stood alone and pressed— a deep frontier worry; he requested to restore and fortify Salt Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Since Pingliang's betrayal the city had fallen; Lingwu hung exposed and Fufang stood alone in peril—he asked to rebuild Salt Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 」乃詔希全及朔方、邠寧、銀夏、鄜坊、振武及神策行營諸節度合選士三萬五千屯鹽州，又敕涇原、劍南、山南軍深入吐蕃，牽撓其力，使不得犯塞。

translations.literal: " Thereupon an edict ordered Xiquan and the military commissioners of Shuofang, Bin-Ning, Yin-Xia, Fufang, Zhenwu, and the Shence field army jointly to select thirty-five thousand elite troops to encamp at Salt Prefecture; it also ordered the Jingyuan, Sword South, and southern Shan armies to penetrate deep into Tibet to pull at their strength so they could not violate the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Xiquan and commissioners of Shuofang, Bin-Ning, Yin-Xia, Fufang, Zhenwu, and the Shence field army to mass thirty-five thousand men at Salt, and ordered Jingyuan, Sword South, and southern Shan to raid Tibet and pin down their strength.

sentences.zh: 執築凡六千人，閱二旬畢。

translations.literal: Those who handled construction numbered six thousand; in twenty days it was completed.
translations.idiomatic: Six thousand laborers finished the work in twenty days.

sentences.zh: 由是虜憚，不輕入。

translations.literal: Thereby the barbarians feared and did not lightly enter.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy thereafter feared to strike lightly.

sentences.zh: 希全居河西久，頗越法橫肆，帝數容掩其短。

translations.literal: Xiquan dwelt long in the western river and quite overstepped the law in arrogant license; the emperor several times tolerated and covered his faults.
translations.idiomatic: Long stationed on the western frontier, Xiquan often broke the law with arrogant license; the emperor repeatedly overlooked his faults.

sentences.zh: 豐州刺史李景略名出希全上，疑逼己，遂排劾之。

translations.literal: The Fengzhou prefect Li Jinglue's fame stood above Xiquan's; suspecting pressure on himself, he thereupon impeached and drove him out.
translations.idiomatic: Fengzhou prefect Li Jinglue outshone him; fearing rivalry, Xiquan impeached and drove him out.

sentences.zh: 帝為斥以答其意。

translations.literal: The emperor dismissed Jinglue to answer his intent.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor removed Jinglue to satisfy him.

sentences.zh: 素苦風眩，稍劇，益忌忍，遂誣殺判官李起，吏下累息。

translations.literal: He had long suffered from wind dizziness; it grew somewhat worse and he became more jealous and cruel; he thereupon falsely accused and killed the judge Li Qi, and the clerks beneath were breathless with fear.
translations.idiomatic: Plagued by vertigo, he grew crueler, falsely killed judge Li Qi, and his staff lived in terror.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈司空。

translations.literal: He died and was posthumously granted Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 邢君牙

translations.literal: Xing Junya
translations.idiomatic: Xing Junya

sentences.zh: 邢君牙，瀛州樂壽人。

translations.literal: Xing Junya was a man of Leshou in Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Junya came from Leshou in Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 少從幽薊、平盧軍，以戰功歷果毅、折沖郎將。

translations.literal: In youth he followed the Youji, Jishan, and Pinglu armies and through battle merit successively held fruiti-corps and vanguard commandant posts.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he served the Youji, Jishan, and Pinglu armies and rose through battle to fruiti-corps and vanguard commandant.

sentences.zh: 安祿山反，從侯希逸涉海入青州。

translations.literal: When An Lushan rebelled, he followed Hou Xiyi across the sea into Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When An Lushan rebelled he followed Hou Xiyi by sea into Qing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 田神功為兗鄆節度使，使君牙將兵屯好畤防盛秋。

translations.literal: Tian Shenggong was military commissioner of Yan-He, and he sent Junya to lead troops to encamp at Haozhi to guard against the height of autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Shenggong of Yan-He sent him to garrison Haozhi against autumn raids.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃犯京師，代宗出陜，以扈從功，累封河間郡公。

translations.literal: When Tibetans raided the capital, Emperor Daizong went out to Shan; for merit in escort he was repeatedly enfeoffed Duke of Hejian Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: When Tibetans struck the capital Daizong withdrew to Shan; for escort merit he was repeatedly enfeoffed Duke of Hejian.

sentences.zh: 建中初，李晟從馬燧討田悅，以君牙為都將，在武安、襄國間凡五戰，斬馘功最。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianzhong, Li Sheng followed Ma Sui to campaign against Tian Yue and made Junya his chief commander; between Wu'an and Xiangguo there were five battles in all, and in beheadings and captures his merit was greatest.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Jianzhong Li Sheng followed Ma Sui against Tian Yue and made Junya his chief commander; fighting between Wu'an and Xiangguo in five battles he took the greatest share of kills and captures.

sentences.zh: 德宗出奉天，晟率君牙倍道赴難，徙屯渭橋，軍中便宜，惟君牙得豫。

translations.literal: When Emperor Dezong went out to Fengtian, Sheng led Junya by double march to rush to the crisis and shifted encampment to the Wei Bridge; within the army whatever was expedient, only Junya was consulted beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: When Dezong withdrew to Fengtian, Sheng led Junya in forced march to the rescue and shifted to the Wei Bridge; on every expedient within the army only Junya was consulted.

sentences.zh: 晟在鳳翔，數行邊，常以君牙守。

translations.literal: When Sheng was at Fengxiang he often patrolled the border and constantly had Junya hold it.
translations.idiomatic: When Sheng was at Fengxiang he often patrolled the frontier and left Junya in command.

sentences.zh: 晟入朝，代為鳳翔觀察使。

translations.literal: When Sheng entered court, Junya replaced him as observation commissioner of Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: When Sheng went to court Junya replaced him as observation commissioner of Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 俄領節度，檢校尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Shortly he also held the commission, Acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he also held the commission and was acting Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃歲犯邊，君牙劭耕講戰以為備，戎不能侵。

translations.literal: The Tibetans yearly raided the border; Junya urged farming and lectured on warfare for preparedness, and the Rong could not invade.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetans raided yearly; Junya urged farming and drilled the troops for war, and the enemy could not break through.

sentences.zh: 又城隴州平戎川，號永信城。

translations.literal: He also fortified Pingrong River in Long Prefecture and named it Yongxin City.
translations.idiomatic: He also fortified Pingrong River in Long Prefecture and named the stronghold Yongxin City.

sentences.zh: 卒官，贈司空。

translations.literal: He died in office and was posthumously granted Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office and was posthumously made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 初，布衣張汾者，無紹而干君牙，軒然坐客上。

translations.literal: At first there was the commoner Zhang Fen, who without introduction approached Junya and loftily sat above the guests.
translations.idiomatic: Early on a commoner named Zhang Fen came unintroduced to Junya and boldly took the seat above the other guests.

sentences.zh: 會吏擿簿書，以盜沒宴錢五萬，君牙怒其欺，汾不謝去，曰：「吾在京師，聞邢君牙一時豪俊，今乃與設吏論錢，云何？

translations.literal: It happened that clerks searched the ledgers and found fifty thousand in banquet funds embezzled; Junya was angry at the deception; Fen did not apologize but departed, saying, "I in the capital heard that Xing Junya was a hero of the age—now you argue money with a petty clerk; how is this?
translations.idiomatic: When clerks audited the books and found fifty thousand strings of banquet funds stolen, Junya raged at the fraud; Fen left without apology and said, "In the capital I heard Xing Junya was a man of the age—now you haggle over money with a petty clerk?

sentences.zh: 」君牙慚，遽釋吏，引為上客，留月餘，以五百縑為謝。

translations.literal: " Junya was ashamed, immediately released the clerk, brought him in as an honored guest, kept him more than a month, and gave five hundred bolts of silk in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: " Junya was ashamed, released the clerk at once, received Fen as an honored guest, kept him over a month, and sent five hundred bolts of silk in thanks.

sentences.zh: 其屈己好士類此。

translations.literal: His humbling himself and loving scholars were of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: He humbled himself and honored men of talent in this fashion.
